service.description: Authorize with the single-use Protect.js token (paymentToken: hpf_token and enc_key; POST /v3/card/authorize/pt-protect), else with the payment method's vault customer (gatewayCimId at this gateway; /v3/card/authorize/customer/{id}). A payment with neither is refused (NO_PAYMENT_PROFILE): card numbers and security codes are not sent from the server. A payment in another currency than the account's is refused (CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED). The idempotency key goes in invoice_number and at the start of description, which a lookup searches after a lost answer.

A sale (/v3/card/sale/pt-protect or /v3/card/sale/customer/{id}): as authorize#Payment, captured at once, then its enhanced data (as capture#Payment). Configure it as the authorizeServiceName with no captureServiceName.

Capture an authorization (/v3/card/batch/capture), the whole or a smaller amount. A capture refused for the transaction's state (816) whose transaction is already captured is a success (ALREADY_CAPTURED). After an approved capture the payment's order or invoice lines go as enhanced data, recorded as their own PgoLevel3Data response: a rejection never undoes or repeats the capture, and send#EnhancedData sends them again.
Void an authorization (/v3/card/batch/void). A void refused for the transaction's state (818) whose transaction is already voided is a success (ALREADY_VOIDED).

Refund linked to the captured transaction, never an unlinked credit. The transaction's state decides, read first: settled, a refund authorization by transaction id of the amount (with the reference, a transaction of its own); captured and not settled, a void of the whole amount recorded as the refund (reasonCode VOID_BEFORE_SETTLEMENT); a partial refund before settlement is refused (REFUND_BEFORE_SETTLEMENT) and nothing is sent.

The payment's transaction status (GET /v3/card/transaction/{id}), as a Payment status. For a lost operation (idempotencyKey given) answers operationFound: a capture or void on the authorization's transaction status; an authorization, sale or refund by its reference (the export by date searched for it, each candidate read to check its invoice number). A PgoTxDetails response records a change only. None found answers false once the lost request is older than lookupGraceSeconds; a search that could not be done leaves it unknown.

Send a captured, unsettled payment's enhanced data (PUT /v3/invoice/by-transaction-id/{id}, a full overwrite): level 3 from its invoice (forInvoiceId) or order lines when they balance with the captured amount, else level 2 (customer reference and invoice number). The capture and sale services register it to run once their transaction commits; an operator or the retry job sends it again. The outcome is a new PgoLevel3Data response, in this service's own transaction; the charge is never sent again. Refuses a payment that is not captured (PAYMENT_NOT_CAPTURED), one voided before settlement (TRANSACTION_VOIDED) or not of a PayTrace gateway. Internal (anonymous-all so it runs after a commit): not for a remote caller.

parameter.name: transactionId
parameter.description: The captured transaction; defaults to the payment's

parameter.name: amount
parameter.description: The captured amount; defaults to the latest capture's

parameter.name: sent
parameter.description: false when the payment has no order or invoice lines, or the gateway sends no enhanced data

service.description: For the retry_PayTraceEnhancedData job: send#EnhancedData for each captured, unsettled payment (with an order or invoice) of a PayTrace gateway whose latest enhanced data was not accepted, or that has none (newest first, within lookBackDays and up to checkLimit), each in its own transaction; one that fails is logged and the others go on. A payment sent maxAttempts times already, or voided before settlement, is left.

Make a PayTrace vault customer from a single-use Protect.js token (POST /v3/customer/create/pt-protect, customer_label "mantle-" and the payment method id). The payment method (the given one, else a new credit card method) keeps gatewayCimId (the vault customer id), gatewayCustomerId (its label), the gateway and only the masked card and expiry; the token is not kept. Refuses a method of another party and a call without a token.

parameter.name: partyId
parameter.description: The owner; defaults to the method's

service.description: Delete the payment method's vault customer at its PayTrace gateway (DELETE /v3/customer/{id}) and clear gatewayCimId. A failure is a warning and keeps the reference, to delete again.

What a browser needs to tokenize a card for this payment with Protect.js: the script address of the connection's environment, a Protect.js client key (valid 20 minutes, made for this page and never kept), and the amount to show. Only the payer, or a user with treasury authority over the organization paid; only an open (promised or declined) payment of a PayTrace gateway.

Authorize the payment with the browser's single-use Protect.js token (hpfToken, encKey); with savePaymentMethod (the payer's consent to keep the card; ignored for anyone but the payer), first make a vault customer from it, put that method on the payment and authorize with it, and delete it again when the card is declined. The payment is locked and checked again; a replay, or an earlier authorization still pending or unknown, sends nothing and makes no vault customer. A payment method of another gateway is refused. The payment decides the organization, gateway, amount and currency; the browser gives only the token, the consent and an operation id (a retry with the same id is answered from the first response). The answer is the gateway response's state: approved, declined, pending, unknown or error. Access as get#BrowserPaymentConfig.

parameter.name: operationId
parameter.description: 8 to 40 letters, digits, - or _, made once per attempt
